title: Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 Review: Indonesia's State Railway Sponsors a Sumatra Race

dek: Set for 20 September 2026 in Bandar Lampung, southern Sumatra, this railway-themed half marathon is backed by PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI), the national state railway operator, though the exact start point hasn't been announced yet.
verdict: The Locomotive Half Marathon is a genuinely distinctive event: it's backed by PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI), the national state railway company, and executed by local organiser RAW Organizer / Runaway Lampung -- a corporate sponsorship angle unlike any other race in this research batch. Three distances (21.1K/10K/5K) in Bandar Lampung, the capital of Lampung province and Sumatra's southern gateway city with over 1.1 million people, give it real urban scale to work with. The exact start point within the city hasn't been confirmed yet, and no independent participant reviews were found -- reasonable gaps for what reads as a newer addition to the regional race calendar.

sections.heading: A Race Sponsored by the National Railway
paragraphs: The race is organised by PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI), the state railway operator, and executed on the ground by RAW Organizer / Runaway Lampung. [1] That's a genuinely unusual sponsorship pairing among the races in this research batch -- a national transport utility backing a community road race rather than a sportswear or beverage brand -- and the 'Locomotive' name leans directly into that railway identity.

sections.heading: Three Distances in Sumatra's Southern Gateway
paragraphs: Distances offered are 21.1K, 10K and 5K, held in Bandar Lampung. [1] Bandar Lampung is the capital and largest city of Lampung province, sitting at the southern tip of Sumatra at the head of Lampung Bay, with a 2020 census population of just over 1.16 million. [2] As the chief port and transport hub for a major agricultural export region (rubber, tea, coffee, pepper), it's a city with real logistical infrastructure behind it, even if it's less internationally known than Jakarta or Surabaya.
